title: ChartQuest Authored Trade-Experience Object
description: THE single source of truth for the shape of an authored TRADE EXPERIENCE (the felt journey of one open trade). Companion to CHARTQUEST_TRADE_EXPERIENCE_CONSTITUTION.md (TEC). This schema owns the FEELING and the AGENCY of a trade; it REFERENCES trade truth/outcome (docs/canon/trading_canon.md), candle geometry (CHARTQUEST_VISUAL_MARKET_CONSTITUTION.md), lesson placement (CHARTQUEST_LESSON_SCHEMA.json), and the confidence journey (CHARTQUEST_TRADING_EXPERIENCE_SYSTEM_v1.1.md). Version 0.1.0 — PROPOSED, pending founder ratification of ADR-TX-1. Not canon until ratified.
$comment: FROZEN INTENT (see TEC): (T1) A trade authors FEELING and POSITION, never OUTCOME or ODDS. There is deliberately NO probability/winRate/quality-to-outcome field in this schema; quality is a firewalled read owned by trading_canon Rule 21 and MUST NOT appear here (guards N2/TMNE-10). (T2) The authored result is REFERENCED from the lesson's apply.honestOutcome (win|loss|scratch), owned by trading_canon — never re-decided here. (T3) Every trade instantiates exactly ONE curveTemplate (EC-LAW-1). (T4) Every phase in phaseBudget is present and non-zero (EP-LAW-1); EP-4 (the Scare) dwell >= 0.25 except curveTemplate=comfortable_winner which may be shallow but never zero (EP-LAW-2). (T5) tier=GATED templates/agency are inert until the Trading-V2 kill-chain clears (N1/EC-LAW-3); shipping one as NOW is a violation. (T6) validationRules are TX-* ids resolved in TEC Part XI — the sole trade-experience registry.

schemaVersion.description: The version of THIS schema the object conforms to.

status.description: Lifecycle state (mirrors the Trade contract in CHARTQUEST_AUTHORING_PIPELINE.md and the lesson state machine).

lessonRef.description: The lessonId this trade applies (CHARTQUEST_LESSON_SCHEMA.json). The trade's learningObjective and taught concepts are OWNED there and referenced here — never re-owned (TA1).

guardian.description: Placement, REFERENCED from the lesson (D1): 0 = The Gambler; 1..9 = Guardians; 10 = Market Maker. Never authored independently of the lesson.

realismTier.description: TES A5 Realism Transition tier (1 Authored / 2 Hybrid / 3 Authentic). REFERENCED, not owned. Controls which agency tier is legal.

curveTemplate.description: The ONE Emotional Curve Template this trade instantiates (EC-1..EC-10, TEC Part VII). Exactly one (EC-LAW-1/T3). New values are added only by ADR.

intendedFeeling.description: One sentence, the target emotion authored FIRST (core principle, PL-1). E.g. 'held through fear and was right.'

phaseBudget.description: Dwell allocation across the six intra-trade phases (EP-1..EP-6, TEC Part III), as fractions of the trade's candle budget. Every phase present and > 0 (EP-LAW-1). This is what makes 'trade length' a choreographed beat-budget, not a raw candle count (TEC Part VII challenge to the 15-20-candle premise). The absolute candle count is REFERENCED from trading_canon §9 duration tiers, not set here.

exposure.description: EP-1. Entry ceremony beat (freeze+zoom); risk visible before hope (Commandment 5).

scare.description: EP-4. The sacred drawdown (Commandment 7). >= 0.25 for all templates except comfortable_winner (shallow, never zero) — enforced by TX-06/TX-07 (T4).

verdict.description: EP-6. Outcome delivery beat, then hands to Review (trading_canon §7).

agencyBeats.description: The in-trade decisions available to the player (TEC Part V). Non-Intro trades expose >= 1 (TX-11). Each beat MUST change the player's realized result — no theater (AG-LAW-1/TX-12). A beat's concept MUST be taught() before it is offered (AG-LAW-2/TX-09).

tier.description: NOW = authored/expressive (realized result along the authored path; ships staging-only, outcome byte-unchanged). GATED = consequential (needs the author-first honest-outcome engine; inert until the kill-chain clears — T5/N1).

phase.description: Where in the journey the decision surfaces (the Scare, EP-4, is the canonical seat of hold-vs-exit).

conceptRef.description: The taught() conceptKey this decision relies on. Must be taught at guardian <= this.guardian (never test the untaught; trading_canon Rule 20).

changesRealizedResult.description: A choice that changes nothing is Agency Theater and is forbidden (TMNE-6/TX-12). Must be true.

onChoice.description: Plain-words: what each choice does to the player's realized P&L along the AUTHORED path (never to the path itself). E.g. 'hold -> full authored target; exit -> book current P&L; both are honest and never scolded.'

outcomeRef.description: REFERENCE to the authored honest outcome, OWNED by trading_canon (Rule 3/5) and the lesson's apply.honestOutcome. This schema never decides win/loss and never carries odds (T1/T2).

source.description: Pointer to the owning authored scenario (e.g. the lesson apply.tradeScenarioRef).

honestOutcome.description: MIRRORS the trading_canon-owned authored result. Present here only so the emotional template can be validated against it; it is a copy-by-reference, and trading_canon governs on any conflict.

causeOnReplay.description: For losses: the on-chart candle/level where the read failed, named on the replay (Commandment 8; trading_canon §7). Forbids the Gaslit Loss (TMNE-11).

witness.description: Companion (Finn) emotional delivery per phase (Witness Law, TX-02). Every phase emotion computed for the companion MUST be rendered, not discarded (fixes shellEmotion :12824). HOW Finn emotes is owned by the Finn Canonical Character System (no arms, no eyebrows); this only requires THAT he reacts at the Scare and the Verdict.

scareReaction.description: EP-4: the visible fear beat (posture/expression/sweat). Non-run.png surface.

verdictReaction.description: EP-6: the visible outcome beat (vindication or honest disappointment).

nonAudioChannel.description: The reaction survives mute (TX-04). Must be true.

juice.description: Feedback delivery on resolution (Witness & Juice Contract, TEC Part IV). Intensities per channel. THE PARITY LAW (TX-01): win intensity >= the symmetric loss intensity on EVERY channel — a cross-field assertion the TX-01 validator enforces (JSON Schema alone cannot compare the two objects). Intensity scales with what was EARNED, not P&L (TX-03).

win.description: Amplified on dismissLesson (celebrate() :12146) — AFTER the learning card (B10 sequencing LOCKED: amplify, never re-order).

loss.description: The symmetric loss feedback the win must meet or exceed.

validationRules.description: TX-* ids that gate this trade, resolved in TEC Part XI (the sole trade-experience registry, T6). Composes with — never restates — VR-*/V-*/TES Forbidden ids.

notes.description: Author notes; never carries a rule or a number that another document owns.

juiceChannels.description: Per-channel feedback intensities, 0..1. Every channel that carries meaning has a non-colour, non-audio redundancy (TX-04); colour/audio are reinforcement only.
